SELECT cd.timestamp AS time, cd.valeur AS value, COALESCE(s.nom, 'Station') || ' / ' || COALESCE(b.nom, 'Borne') || ' / emplacement ' || COALESCE(e.numero::text, '-') AS metric
FROM capteur_data cd
JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
LEFT JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
LEFT JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE c.type = 'temperature' AND $__timeFilter(cd.timestamp)
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
ORDER BY cd.timestamp;

WHERE c.type = 'power' AND $__timeFilter(cd.timestamp)
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')

SELECT a.date AS time, a.type, a.niveau_severite, a.status, COALESCE(s.nom, '-') AS station, COALESCE(b.nom, '-') AS borne, COALESCE(e.numero::text, '-') AS emplacement, a.message
FROM alerte a
LEFT JOIN charging_session cs ON cs.id_session = a.id_session
LEFT JOIN emplacement session_emplacement ON session_emplacement.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN capteur_data cd ON cd.id_data = a.id_data
LEFT JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
LEFT JOIN emplacement sensor_emplacement ON sensor_emplacement.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
LEFT JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = COALESCE(session_emplacement.id_emplacement, sensor_emplacement.id_emplacement)
LEFT JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
LEFT JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.date)
  AND ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
ORDER BY a.date DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT s.nom AS station, b.nom AS borne, e.numero AS emplacement, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.slot_id, ''), NULLIF(d.mac_address, ''), 'emplacement ' || e.numero::text) AS controleur, d.status AS etat, d.last_seen AS dernier_signal, d.firmware_version AS firmware, d.ip_address AS adresse_ip
FROM device d
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE ('${station:raw}' = 'all' OR s.id_station::text = '${station:raw}')
  AND ('${borne:raw}' = 'all' OR b.id_borne::text = '${borne:raw}')
  AND ('${emplacement:raw}' = 'all' OR e.id_emplacement::text = '${emplacement:raw}')
ORDER BY d.last_seen DESC NULLS LAST;
